title: Lots of great stuff going on …

body:
Here’s a recent article I wrote for Huffington Post – “A Fertile Summer for Violence”:

 http://www.huffingtonpost.com/brian-d-mclaren/fertile-summer-for-violence_b_1753787.html

Here’s an interview with one of my favorite podcasts – Voices of Peace:

 http://www.ravenfoundation.org/blogs/voices-of-peace-talk-radio/theologian-brian-mclaren-on-voices-of-peace-talk-radio

One of the brightest and most hope-inspiring young Christian leaders you’ll meet – Brandan Robinson – interviewed me about my new book for his podcast, re-vangelical, here:

It can be downloaded on itunes here: http://itunes.apple.com/us/podcast/re-vangelical-podcast/id526564741

And by direct link here: http://thebridgemcr.hipcast.com/deluge/85338446-d847-43bf-aed7-221441b09fa8.mp3

Here’s a powerful new film called the Line – you really should see it:

 http://www.thelinemovie.com

Here’s a fantastic set of slides from Bruce Reyes Chow on 10 unhelpful things to say about race: http://www.slideshare.net/breyeschow/10-unhelpful-things-we-say-about-race

And here’s an excellent piece about race and inclusion by Holly Roach:

 http://www.patheos.com/blogs/emergentvillage/2012/09/emergents-need-to-embrace-anti-oppression-with-inclusivity-and-humility/#comment-5091 ‘

Here’s a great piece on immigration reform: http://wirelesshogan.blogspot.com/2010/09/immigration-reform-perspectives-from.html
